messages:
kai-sales: Cedar Analytics asked for a focused perf POC next Monday. Target: sustain 180 qps, avg response ~600 tokens, p95 < 200ms. They want a one-page runbook + committed-cost estimate.

orge-eng: 180 qps @ 600 tokens is reasonable. We'll run Redwood-22B optimized primary, 7B-quant fallback. Need prompt/completion split and streaming preference.

maya-ml: Test mix: 70% short (40-180 tokens), 25% medium (250-500), 5% long (800-1k). We'll include a 20m smoke at 80 qps then ramp to target. We'll log hallucination checks.

tess-ops: Ops plan: reserve 4h window (includes priming). Infra: 2x A100-80GB workers, continuous batching. Priming: 3k prefixes, 10m. We'll provide a curl prime snippet.

sec-bot: For Dedicated: BYOK and region pinning supported. Default POC log retention 30d; we can set 90d for the run on request. SCIM/SAML need Private for full automation.

kai-sales: Cedar asked about an order-of-magnitude committed cost for comparison to on-prem. Can you give GPU-hours -> monthly band?

orge-eng: Quick heuristic: 2x A100 sustained ~2 GPU-hours per hour of steady-state. For a production bundle to cover sustained 180 qps, expect 2-4 GPUs reserved monthly depending on headroom. I'll post a small table tomorrow.

maya-ml: Observability items: per-request token_count, model_variant, kv_hit_rate, p50/p95/p99. We'll run evals at start/end to catch regressions.

kai-sales: Action items: (1) I'll get Cedar IP list + SSO contact today. (2) Tess reserve pool Mon 08:00-12:00 UTC. (3) Orge/maya finalize priming list + fallback policy by EOD. (4) Orge to post GPU-hour -> price bands.

tess-ops: Reserved and INF-5007 created. Calendar invite sent.

kai-sales: Thanks team — I'll update Cedar. :thumbsup:
